hesiod_config.description: List of configuration directives for hesiod.conf. Each item specifies a key-value pair and an optional comment for clarity. Keys must match documented hesiod.conf options (e.g., 'lhs', 'rhs', 'extensions'). Values are bare strings or numbers; empty values are allowed where documented (e.g., 'rhs' may be absent in minimal config). Comments should be short, human-readable annotations (e.g., 'Primary DNS suffix for left-hand side of Hesiod names'). See hesiod.conf(5).
